cases.title: Two pipes arrive at P83; Edit Pipe raises one of them 200 mm and Recalculate downstream keeps the outgoing pipe under the lower one, and says so

cases.expected: Four pits P81 to P84 and three pipes (P81->P83 18.050 / 17.950, P82->P83 18.000 / 17.900, P83->P84 17.880 / 17.780), no Grade mismatch window. The preview window's own wording is recorded only. Pit P84's schedule level (17.78) is not read.
DERIVED, not yet seen on a run: every line and level above; that P82 -> P83 is the label the walk builds (BuildPipeLabel, line 707-712, pit numbers from the drawing as 'from P3' in R11).
